blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo emerged as the leading potential senatorial candidate for the 2028 elections, dislodging fellow Sen. Robin Padilla from the top spot, based on the latest survey conducted by Octa Research. The non-commissioned “Tugon ng Masa” survey, conducted from September 28 to October 4, 2026, presented respondents with a hypothetical list of senatorial candidates for the May 2028 elections. They were asked: “I have here a list of names that may run in the May 2028 elections. If the May 2028 elections will be held today, who will you likely vote for as SENATOR? You may choose […]...
